title: Anti-Ragging Cell | KPGU
content: ac.in UGC Website Portal COMMITTEE WORK Functions of the Ragging Committee To design strategies and action plans for curbing the menace of ragging on the university campus. To plan awareness campaigns about moral and ethical principles, human rights, dignity, and gender. To investigate the complaints that students have made about ragging and to investigate this matter. To formulate strategies to prevent and discourage the menace of ragging on and off the campus.
